title: Bugs Bunny with Looney Tunes characters
description: A large Bugs Bunny stands in the center with his hands on his hips smiling at the viewer. Several smaller Looney Tunes characters surround him including a small bear on a striped ball to the left a duck and devil character on a striped ball to the right and two tiny characters on the ground near a small wooden box.
prompt: A large gray Bugs Bunny stands in the center with hands on hips smiling with big teeth and long ears. Smaller cartoon characters surround him: a small orange bear with crown on a striped ball to the left, a black devil character and duck on a red and white striped ball to the right, plus two tiny characters on the ground near a wooden box. Circus tent element in background with blue and beige painted walls. Painted red marks on the floor.
